lock.encoding: label 0 if the selected neuron's own 200 ms spike trace is at least 0.5; otherwise label 1

channel.target: the first eight VPN neurons of label lane 0 or 1

lock.selectionRule: highest calibration increase in conditional information about next opponent move given previous move, among mid/mbon/dn/pam/ppl1 neurons and three prespecified binary activity thresholds with 10-90% activation; positive gain on each of three calibration seeds
lock.note: The encoded bit is raw Fly A neural activity; it uses no opponent move, hidden strategy label, learned weights, or external decoder at transmission time.
